evals.name: incremental-employee-sync
evals.prompt: 我们要把北森 iTalent 里的员工同步到自己的数据仓库：首次全量（大约 2 万人，含已离职和实习生），之后每小时增量一次，只关心业务上的变化（入转调离、改部门、改经理）。需要每个人当前所在部门和直线经理。我手上有 tenant_id、app_id 和 AppSecret。用 Python 写这个同步脚本。
evals.expected_output: 脚本用表单 POST https://openapi.italent.cn/OAuth/Token 换 token 并缓存，调用 POST /TenantBaseExternal/api/v5/Employee/GetByTimeWindow，Authorization: Bearer；按 ≤90 天切时间窗，用 scrollId 连续滚动、先拉完再处理，data 为空时结束；timeWindowQueryType=2（业务修改时间）、isGetLatestRecord=false、withDisabled=true 且 employType 含实习生；业务 code 按字符串判断。
expectations: [doc-vs-probe 2026-09-11] Token is obtained with POST https://openapi.italent.cn/OAuth/Token (not /token) using a form-encoded body (application/x-www-form-urlencoded), not JSON
Token request sends grant_type=client_credentials together with tenant_id, app_id and secret

Business calls send the header Authorization: Bearer followed by the access_token, and call the v3.0 path /TenantBaseExternal/api/v5/Employee/GetByTimeWindow with POST and a JSON body (not a GET with page/pageSize)
Requests pass scrollId (empty string on the first call, then the scrollId from the previous response) and stop when data is null or empty rather than relying on isLastData
The full-history pull is split into time windows of at most 90 days, and capacity is at most 300
The scroll loop collects all batches before doing slow processing (or explicitly keeps calls within 10 seconds), acknowledging that the scrollId expires if calls are more than 10 seconds apart
Incremental runs use timeWindowQueryType 2 (business modified time) rather than 1, or explicitly explain the difference between ModifiedTime and BusinessModifiedTime

Sets isGetLatestRecord to false (current effective record) when reading the current department, and includes departed employees via withDisabled true (or explicit empStatus) and trainees via employType including 2
Treats the business code as a string (for example compares str(code) to '200') and surfaces code '417' messages instead of retrying them

evals.name: transfer-by-job-number
evals.prompt: OA 系统每天会给我们一份调岗清单（CSV：工号、新部门的北森组织 OId、新直线经理的工号、生效日期），大概 200 行。帮我用 Python 写个脚本，读 CSV 后在北森里把这些员工直接调动过去，失败的行输出到一个错误文件。北森的 token 获取我已经有函数 get_token() 了。
evals.expected_output: 脚本先用 POST /TenantBaseExternal/api/v5/Employee/GetUserIDsByJobNumbers 按每批 ≤30 个工号反查 UserID（员工和经理），逐条检查 data[].code；再逐条调用 POST /TenantBaseExternal/api/v5/Employee/Transfer，body 含 userId（不同时传 originalId）和 employmentRecord.oIdDepartment / pOIdEmpAdmin / startDate；按字符串 code 判断 417 并写入错误文件；重试遵守 3 秒防重。
expectations: Resolves job numbers to UserIDs with POST /TenantBaseExternal/api/v5/Employee/GetUserIDsByJobNumbers using the jobNumbers field
Chunks job numbers into batches of at most 30 per call
Checks the per-item data[].code (and msg) of the job-number lookup and does not use userId from items whose code is not 200, even though the outer code is '200'

Calls POST /TenantBaseExternal/api/v5/Employee/Transfer with userId at the top level and employmentRecord containing oIdDepartment (the new department) plus the manager as pOIdEmpAdmin and the effective date
Sends exactly one of userId or originalId for the employee being transferred, never both
Compares the response code as a string and records code '417' responses with their message to the error file without blindly retrying
Any retry of the same Transfer request waits more than 3 seconds, or the script explains the documented 3-second duplicate-request rule
Sends Authorization: Bearer with the token and a JSON body to https://openapi.italent.cn

evals.name: push-punches-and-confirm
evals.prompt: 我们的门禁系统每 10 分钟导出一批打卡记录（员工北森 UserId、打卡时间、门禁点名称），一次可能有两三千条。写一个 Python 函数把它们推送到北森假勤，并且要能确认这批数据真的进了北森，没进的要告警。
evals.expected_output: 函数调用 POST /AttendanceOpen/api/v1/SwipingCardData/PostAsync，body 用 DataSourceType=14、PrimaryKeyType=1、Items[{PrimaryKey, CardDateTime, LocationTitle}]，每次 ≤1000 条分批；把响应 Code 200 视为仅受理，读取响应头 X-PAAS-Request-ID，轮询 GET /OpenPlatform/api/AsyncApiExecInfo/GetByRequestId?requestId=… 直到 state 不是 Running，PartialSuccess / Fail 时读 message 告警。
expectations: Posts to /AttendanceOpen/api/v1/SwipingCardData/PostAsync on https://openapi.italent.cn with Authorization: Bearer
Body sets DataSourceType to 14 and PrimaryKeyType to 1 (Beisen UserId) and puts records in an Items array using PrimaryKey and CardDateTime fields (PascalCase as documented)
Splits the records into batches of at most 1000 items per request
Does not treat a 200 / Code 200 response as proof the punches were stored; explains the push is asynchronous
Reads the X-PAAS-Request-ID response header (not a body field) from each push response
Polls GET /OpenPlatform/api/AsyncApiExecInfo/GetByRequestId with requestId as a query parameter, with a non-trivial interval, until data.state is no longer Running
Raises an alert when data.state is PartialSuccess, Fail or Overtime and includes data.message
Reads the push response status from the capitalised Code / Message fields (or handles both Code and code)
